hosting.//: Firebase's default ignore list contains '**/.*', which silently excludes .well-known and would make did:web resolution 404. Exclusions are enumerated explicitly instead.

rewrites.//: The one endpoint that cannot be a static file: Hosting cannot route on a query string, so `cursor` needs a request-time handler. Exact path, never /xrpc/**, so nothing else can be captured by it. pinTag is deliberately omitted -- it requires an opt-in experiment, forces functions into the targets of every hosting deploy (which would make the 30-minute loop need function-deploy permissions), and burns a Cloud Run tag per deploy against a 1000/service limit.

headers.//: XRPC endpoints are extensionless, so Firebase would infer application/octet-stream and the AppView's client would reject them. Scoped to this exact path rather than /xrpc/**: header rules are matched before rewrites are applied and override the response's own headers, so a glob here would stamp max-age=300 onto getFeedSkeleton's error responses too.

functions.//: Deploy artifact only: index.js is the esbuild bundle of src/functions/index.ts, entries.json comes from build.ts, and neither is committed. See npm run build:functions.
